says: In next/, the P12 property 'requests that arrive before any read of the recorded start has finished each read for themselves, and a finished read serves the later ones' runs 20 cases with vi.waitFor and takes about 6 s on a loaded laptop, past vitest's 5 s default, so the file goes red for changes that cannot reach it.
proof: nice -n 19 pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 src/cloudflare/fetch.test.ts printed 'Error: Test timed out in 5000ms', 1 failed and 8 passed, three times at 7665fd512 and twice at the base eeb8ecdbb (once without nice), with load averages from 10 to 35; alone with -t and --testTimeout=120000 at eeb8ecdbb it passed with 'Duration 6.38s (tests 95%)'.
cost: Every review or step run of this file on a busy machine can go red for no fault of the change, and a reviewer must rerun it on the base to tell.
